description: Board of Investment of Sri Lanka - Rules to impose or Levy Charges or Fees
reasoning: This gazette content involves the amendment of rules and fees/charges by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka under Section 18 of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka Law, No. 4 of 1978. It contains regulatory changes to land premium rates, ground rent, and annual fees for enterprises in export processing zones and industrial parks. This constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework matters, falling under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel/structure categories.
